findings.title: Test cleanup removes hardcoded alias "alias" instead of the created IDPs
findings.body: In testCacheIDPForLogin the cleanup is registered as `getCleanup().addCleanup(testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove)`, but the IDPs created by the test have aliases like `idp-alias-N` (and an extra `idp-alias-20`). The literal "alias" matches no created provider, so none of the 20+ IDPs are actually deleted and the cleanup issues DELETE requests against a non-existent provider. Consequences: if the realm is not fully reset between tests (or cleanup is strict about 404s) this leaks enabled/public IDPs into the realm and can break the count assertions of later tests in the class (e.g. the `getForLogin(ORG_ONLY/ALL, orgaId)` sizes), and at minimum produces useless/erroneous cleanup calls. The same wrong-alias pattern is repeated at line 425 (and the pre-existing testCacheIDPByOrg line 303). Fix by capturing the created alias in the loop and removing that, e.g. `String alias = "idp-alias-" + i; ... getCleanup().addCleanup(testRealm().identityProviders().get(alias)::remove);`.

findings.title: New login cache test does not cover unlinking/removing organization brokers or deleting an organization
findings.body: testCacheIDPForLogin exercises create/update/remove of IDPs and adding a broker to an organization, but never removes a broker from an organization nor deletes an organization. These org-level mutations are exactly the paths that can change which providers appear in the cached ORG_ONLY/ALL login lists, and the cache is only refreshed if those operations route through IdentityProviderStorageProvider.update()/remove() and register the login-cache invalidation. Without a test asserting that unlinking a broker (organizationId goes non-null -> null) and deleting an organization clear the login caches and update the returned list, a regression in that invalidation (e.g. an org mutation that bypasses the storage provider, leaving deleted/unlinked providers cached) would go unnoticed. Add assertions that the login caches are cleared and the resulting lists are correct after `organizations().get(orgId).identityProviders().removeIdentityProvider(alias)` / organization removal.
